title: Introduction to Electron Microscopy
description: Introduction to Scanning Electron Microscopes, Transmission Electron Microscopes and associated methods of microscopy; phase contrast imaging, diffraction contrast imaging, Z-contrast imaging and analytical electron microscopy; methods for producing microscopy specimens.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of MECH 576, MECH 472, MECH 580 (if taken in the same topic).
